comparison.objective: Release a camera plate from a cam clamp, clear a retaining lip and transfer it upright to a pad.
comparison.physical_skill: Cam actuation, constrained extraction and supported payload transfer, versus bimanual screen manipulation with loose-body flow and retention.
comparison.success_condition: Cam released, payload clear and upright on pad, robot clear and pose stable for 1 s, with drop/fixture guards. Candidate requires quantified separation yield and retained washers before reseating. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: This is release-and-transfer of one captured payload; it does not test selective many-body passage, agitation or simultaneous retained/recovered populations.
